title: Separate Style and Lyrics fields

body.text: (the lyrics + structure tags). Separating them gives much more precise control than Simple Mode — great when you already have a clear vision of the song.

example:
Style: warm acoustic pop, in Thai, female vocals
Lyrics: [Verse] ... [Chorus] ...

title: Set the title and length

body.text: You can set a song name in the Title field and roughly control the length by the number of sections. The more lyrics, the longer the song. For a short song (like a jingle), use just a short 1 Verse + 1 Chorus.

example:
Style: bright 20-second jingle
Lyrics: [Chorus] Fragrant coffee to start a new day

question: What are Custom Mode's main fields?
For a short jingle-style song, what should you do?

options.text: Use short lyrics — just one section

question: What's the benefit of separate Style and Lyrics fields?

options.text: More precise control of style and lyrics than Simple Mode
You get a song without entering anything

question: What most affects the song's length?

options.text: The number of sections / length of the lyrics
